Troubleshooting · 48/50 · localization

Source changes after localization

Failure signal

A source changes after localization condition is reported or detected during localization.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for localization does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Diff dialogue, graphics, timings and glossary terms between localized and current source.

Corrective action

Create a delta package and update only affected cues, graphics and approvals.

Prevention

Add this verification to the localization gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
